    <title>MLflow 3.15.1</title>
    <content type="html"><p>MLflow 3.15.1 is a patch release that includes bug fixes and documentation updates.</p>
<h3>Bug fixes:</h3>
<ul>
<li>[Model Registry] Skip <code>env_pack</code> on ARM client images (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5022642018" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/24762" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24762/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24762">#24762</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/qyc/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/qyc">@qyc</a>)</li>
<li>[Scoring / Tracking] Harden version parsing against missing/non-PEP440 versions on Databricks Serverless (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5029376850" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/24799" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24799/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24799">#24799</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/PattaraS/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/PattaraS">@PattaraS</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Documentation updates:</h3>

    <title>v3.15.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>MLflow 3.15.0 includes several major features and improvements</p>
<h3>Major New Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>🧩 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/mcp-registry/" rel="nofollow">MCP Registry</a></strong>: A centralized catalog for registering, versioning, and sharing Model Context Protocol servers — with semantic-versioned configs, promotable aliases, tags, auto-discovered tools, and ready-made connection instructions for Claude Code and <code>.mcp.json</code>. Manage it from the UI, REST API, or Python!</li>
<li><strong>🤖 MLflow Assistant enhancements</strong>: The in-app AI assistant now supports multiple LLM providers (Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible/Gateway endpoints) chosen from a single settings page, displays live per-session token usage and estimated cost in the composer, and is easier to set up — <code>mlflow agent setup</code> can enable it in one prompt, with API keys stored securely in the Gateway's LLM Connections.</li>
<li><strong>🗂️ Sharable table views</strong>: Save named views of the Runs table — capturing columns, order, widths, filters, and sort — and share them by URL.</li>
<li><strong>⚡ Proxy-less artifact upload/download via presigned URLs</strong>: Large artifact transfers can now bypass the tracking server and talk directly to cloud storage (e.g. S3) through presigned URLs, cutting server load and timeouts on big files. We fall back to proxied transfer automatically for backward compatibility.</li>
<li><strong>🖼️ Multi-modal attachments in LLM judges</strong>: <code>{{ trace }}</code> judges created with <code>make_judge()</code> can now <em>see</em> images captured in trace spans via a new <code>get_span_image</code> tool, which fetches attachments as base64 data URLs and passes them to multimodal models (Anthropic, Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible via litellm) — enabling evaluation of vision tasks, screenshots, and other visual content.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Other Assorted Features &amp; Improvements:</h3>

<li>[Tracing / Tracking] Add Pydantic AI 2.x autologging support (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5005557680" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/24721" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24721/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24721">#24721</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/B-Step62/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/B-Step62">@B-Step62</a>)</li>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/136202695/v3.14.0</id>

    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/releases/tag/v3.14.0"/>
    <title>v3.14.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>MLflow 3.14.0 includes several major features and improvements</p>
<h3>Major New Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>🚀 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/tracing/quickstart/" rel="nofollow">One-command agent onboarding with <code>mlflow agent setup</code></a></strong>: Install MLflow, set up tracing, and hand your favorite coding agent (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or OpenCode) the MLflow skills to instrument your app, all from a single command.</li>
<li><strong>⚡ <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/tracing/integrations/listing/claude_code" rel="nofollow">Durable, low-latency tracing for Claude Code</a></strong>: Roll out Claude Code tracing across a team with confidence: a write-ahead-log keeps it from slowing the agent, overwhelming the tracking server, or losing traces on a network blip or crash.</li>
<li><strong>📝 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/assessments/review-queues" rel="nofollow">Review Queues for traces</a></strong>: Assign traces to reviewers (or agents) and collect structured feedback and ground-truth annotations in the UI, written straight back onto the trace so they are immediately usable for evaluation.</li>
<li><strong>🗂️ <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/datasets/" rel="nofollow">Revamped evaluation dataset UI</a></strong>: Browse, inspect, edit, and bulk-manage evaluation dataset records directly in the UI, with click-through to the source trace.</li>
<li><strong>🧪 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/regression-testing" rel="nofollow">Pytest integration for regression testing</a></strong>: Write GenAI regression tests as plain pytest functions with the <code>@mlflow.test</code> marker, gate them in CI, and review test history and per-assertion judge results in the UI.</li>
<li><strong>🎛️ <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/prompt-registry/playground" rel="nofollow">LLM Playground</a></strong>: Iterate on prompts in the browser against your AI Gateway endpoints and Prompt Registry versions, with settings, tools, structured output, and template variables.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Breaking Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>[Models] Change <code>mlflow.sklearn</code> <code>serialization_format</code> default from <code>cloudpickle</code> to <code>skops</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4661986025" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/23987" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23987/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23987">#23987</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/copilot-swe-agent/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/copilot-swe-agent">@copilot-swe-agent</a>)</li>
<li>[Models] Change <code>serialization_format</code> default to <code>"pt2"</code> for <code>mlflow.pytorch.log_model</code> and <code>mlflow.pytorch.save_model</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4661990269" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/23988" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23988/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23988">#23988</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/copilot-swe-agent/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/copilot-swe-agent">@copilot-swe-agent</a>)</li>
<li>[Models] Change <code>serialization_format</code> default to <code>"skops"</code> in <code>mlflow.lightgbm</code> <code>log_model</code>/<code>save_model</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4661956309" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/23986" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23986/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23986">#23986</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/copilot-swe-agent/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/copilot-swe-agent">@copilot-swe-agent</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Other Assorted Features &amp; Improvements:</h3>

    <title>v3.13.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>MLflow 3.13.0 includes several major features and improvements</p>
<h3>Major New Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>🔐 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/security/role-based-access-control" rel="nofollow">Role-Based Access Control &amp; Admin UI</a></strong>: A full RBAC system with reusable roles and workspace-scoped grants, plus a new web Admin UI for managing users, roles, and permissions on self-hosted MLflow.</li>
<li><strong>🗄️ <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/tracing/observe-with-traces/archive-traces" rel="nofollow">Trace Retention &amp; Auto Archival</a></strong>: Automatically move aged trace span data out of your SQL backend into object storage (e.g. S3) while keeping every trace fully readable in the UI and APIs.</li>
<li><strong>🤖 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/governance/ai-gateway/coding-agents/" rel="nofollow">One-click observability &amp; governance for coding agents</a></strong>: Onboard Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Gemini CLI to the AI Gateway in one click for tracing, usage tracking, budgets, and guardrails.</li>
<li><strong>✨ <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/getting-started/try-assistant/" rel="nofollow">New engines for MLflow Assistant</a></strong>: Run MLflow Assistant on a local Ollama model, the OpenAI Codex CLI, or any MLflow AI Gateway endpoint, in addition to Claude Code.</li>
<li><strong>☸️ <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/kubernetes-helm" rel="nofollow">Helm chart for Kubernetes</a></strong>: An official, production-ready Helm chart for deploying the MLflow tracking server to any Kubernetes cluster.</li>
<li><strong>🌐 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/governance/ai-gateway/coding-agents/hermes-agent" rel="nofollow">Hermes Agent support</a></strong>: Route the Hermes Agent runtime through the AI Gateway and capture its end-to-end traces in MLflow over OpenTelemetry.</li>
<li><strong>🪵 <a href="https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/tracing/app-instrumentation/logging" rel="nofollow">Span log levels</a></strong>: Python-<code>logging</code>-style severity levels on spans, with a "Minimum log level" filter in the trace UI to hide low-level noise.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Breaking Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>The permission system has been overhauled into a unified Role-Based Access Control model. The legacy per-resource permission tables, REST endpoints, and client methods are removed and replaced by roles backed by <code>role_permissions</code>, <code>default_permission</code> now acts as a floor rather than an override, and a workspace <code>USE</code> grant is sufficient to create experiments and registered models. Code that relied on the old per-resource permission APIs must migrate to the new role-based APIs. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4321526503" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22855" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22855/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22855">#22855</a>, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4321822357" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22859" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22859/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22859">#22859</a>, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4337264018" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22941" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22941/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22941">#22941</a>, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4448220146" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/23337" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23337/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23337">#23337</a>, <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4459273330" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/23379" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23379/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23379">#23379</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/PattaraS/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/PattaraS">@PattaraS</a>)</li>
<li>MLServer is no longer available as a pyfunc serving backend.     <title>v3.13.0rc0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>We're excited to announce MLflow 3.13.0rc0, which deepens agent observability, tightens permissions, and broadens deployment options:</p>
<p><strong>Major New Features</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>RBAC + Admin UI</strong>: Major overhaul of MLflow's Role-Based Access Control — legacy per-resource permission tables collapsed into <code>role_permissions</code>, unified per-user permission APIs under <code>/mlflow/users/permissions/*</code>, workspace <code>USE</code> permission lets users create experiments and registered models, default roles are seeded on workspace creation, <code>prompt</code> is promoted to a first-class RBAC <code>resource_type</code>, and a new 4-page Admin UI (account widget, <code>/account</code> page, Platform Admin pages, backend auth endpoints) opens to workspace managers scoped per their workspace. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4321526503" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22855" </li>
<li>
<p><strong>Coding-Agent Tracing as Plugins</strong>: Claude Code, OpenClaw, Ollama, and OpenAI Codex are now wired into the AI Gateway as first-class assistant providers, plus a Claude Code TypeScript plugin with a setup wizard and <code>settings.local.json</code> support. The legacy Python autolog hook for <code>mlflow autolog claude</code> is replaced by the new official plugin, and a coding-agent endpoint creation flow is now available directly in the AI Gateway UI. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3865263470" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/20414" href="https://github.com/TomeHirata">@TomeHirata</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Trace Archival</strong>: End-to-end trace archival across the tracking stack. Includes archival configuration models, OTLP and artifact helpers, SQLAlchemy archival passes, archive-aware retrieval fallback, plus workspace/experiment/server-level archival settings in the UI. Read archived traces back seamlessly. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4454519067" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/23359" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23359/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/23359">#23359</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/mprahl/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/mprahl">@mprahl</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Helm Charts for Kubernetes Deployment</strong>: First-class Helm chart for deploying MLflow to Kubernetes clusters — production-ready configuration, ingress, persistence, and <code>appVersion</code> wired to the released MLflow image. Get from <code>helm install</code> to a running tracking server without writing your own manifests. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4128760981" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/21973" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/21973/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/21973">#21973</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/WeichenXu123/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/WeichenXu123">@WeichenXu123</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>mlflow.genai.test_agent</code> for Automated Agent Stress-Testing</strong>: New API for stress-testing GenAI agents — generate adversarial inputs, replay them through your agent, and review the resulting traces in MLflow. Wires into the existing evaluation flow and assessment APIs. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4349543372" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22990" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22990/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22990">#22990</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/serena-ruan/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/serena-ruan">@serena-ruan</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>OpenTelemetry Span Links</strong>: Tracing now supports the OpenTelemetry <code>Link</code> entity via <code>LiveSpan.add_link()</code>, letting you connect causally related spans across traces. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4311620181" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22797" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22797/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22797">#22797</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/khaledsulayman/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/khaledsulayman">@khaledsulayman</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Database Replica Routing</strong>: The SQL tracking store now supports reader/writer instance routing for database replicas, so read-heavy MLflow deployments can scale horizontally without overloading the primary. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4332278227" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/22910" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22910/hovercard" href="https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/22910">#22910</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/ravidarbha/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/ravidarbha">@ravidarbha</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Stay tuned for the full release, which will include even more features and bug fixes.</p>
<p>To try out this release candidate, please run:</p>
<p><code>pip install mlflow==3.13.0rc0</code></p></content>
